description: Capability for the main window and per-artifact pop-out windows (label pattern "artifact:*", see openArtifactWindow/printArtifactWindow in lib/windows.ts) — the pop-out is first-party app chrome (ArtifactWindowView), not the sandboxed artifact iframe it hosts, so it shares the main window's grant rather than getting a narrower one. Needed there for core:webview:allow-print (native print) and core:event (the cross-window print trigger).
